units.source_text: 匂亲王回到二条院，并不立刻到二女公子房中，暂在自己室内休息。

en.t: Prince Niou returned to the Nijo estate, but instead of going at once to the Second Princess's rooms, he rested for a while in his own chamber.

units.source_text: 一觉醒来，就写慰问信给六女公子。

en.t: When he woke from a sleep, he wrote a letter of consolation to the Sixth Princess.

units.source_text: 旁边的侍女们交头接耳地议论：“看来恩情不浅呢！”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting nearby whispered among themselves, "It seems his affection is no shallow thing."

units.source_text: 又说：“这里的夫人真可怜。

en.t: They also said, "The lady here is truly to be pitied.

units.source_text: 即使爱情两方平均，那边威势盛大，这里恐被压倒呢。”

en.t: Even if his love were equal on both sides, the other lady has such powerful standing that this one may well be overwhelmed."

units.source_text: 这些不是普通侍女，都是贴身服侍匂亲王的人，故对此事深感不满，发了许多牢骚，殿内充满了醋味。

en.t: These were not ordinary attendants, but women who served Prince Niou closely, and so they were deeply displeased by the affair, complained a great deal, and filled the residence with jealousy.

units.source_text: 匂亲王本想在自己室中等待六条院回信，但昨晚一夜不曾见二女公子，似觉比往常外宿更加挂念，可怜她不知怎么样了，因此连忙来到她房中。

en.t: Prince Niou had meant to wait in his own room for a reply from Rokujo, but because he had not seen the Second Princess all the previous night, he felt more anxious about her than after an ordinary night away, wondered sadly how she was, and hurried to her rooms.

units.source_text: 二女公子刚刚醒来，容姿异常娇美。

en.t: The Second Princess had just awakened, and her appearance was unusually delicate and beautiful.

units.source_text: 她看见匂亲王进来，觉得躺着不好意思，略微抬起身子。

en.t: Seeing Prince Niou enter, she felt embarrassed to remain lying down and raised herself a little.

units.source_text: 匂亲王看见她两眼微肿，红晕满颊，觉得今天比往常更加艳丽，便不知不觉地流下泪来。

en.t: Prince Niou saw that her eyes were slightly swollen and her cheeks flushed, and thinking her even lovelier than usual today, he unconsciously shed tears.

units.source_text: 他默默地向她注视了一会。

en.t: For a while he gazed at her in silence.

units.source_text: 二女公子难以为情，低下了头。

en.t: The Second Princess felt painfully embarrassed and lowered her head.

units.source_text: 鬒发如云，冉冉下垂，姿色毕竟独擅其美。

en.t: Her rich black hair hung down like clouds, and after all, her beauty stood apart from all others.

units.source_text: 匂亲王心虚胆怯，一时说不出殷勤慰藉的话来。

en.t: Feeling guilty and timid, Prince Niou could not at first find any tender words of comfort.

units.source_text: 大约他想混蒙过去，故意说别的事：“你为什么身体一直不好呢？

en.t: Perhaps wanting to cover things over, he deliberately turned to another subject and said, "Why has your health remained so poor?

units.source_text: 以前你说是天气炎热之故，我就盼待天凉。

en.t: Before, you said it was because of the heat, so I waited eagerly for cooler weather.

units.source_text: 现已到了秋天，而你还是不见好转，真气人啊！

en.t: Now autumn has come, yet you still show no sign of improvement, which is truly distressing.

units.source_text: 做了种种祈祷，一点效验也没有，却也奇怪。

en.t: We have offered all kinds of prayers, and it is strange that they have had no effect at all.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，法事还是继续举行为是。

en.t: Even so, it would be best to continue the rites.

units.source_text: 找得到法术灵验的高僧才好！

en.t: If only we could find an eminent monk whose rituals truly have power.

units.source_text: 请某僧官来做夜祈祷吧。”

en.t: Let us invite some priestly official to perform night prayers."

units.source_text: 说了一篇冠冕堂皇的话。

en.t: He strung together a fine-sounding speech.

units.source_text: 二女公子想：“他在实务方面也能言善辩。”

en.t: The Second Princess thought, "He is eloquent even in practical matters."

units.source_text: 心中颇感不快，但置之不答也不好意思，便对他说：“我的体质向来与他人不一样，现在虽然生病，不久自会痊愈。”

en.t: She felt quite displeased, but it would have been awkward to leave him unanswered, so she said, "My constitution has always been different from other people's. Although I am ill now, I will recover before long."

units.source_text: 匂亲王笑道：“你说得好干脆啊！”

en.t: Prince Niou laughed and said, "How very briskly you put it."

units.source_text: 他觉得在温柔娇媚这方面，无人能与这位二女公子并比。

en.t: He felt that in gentleness and seductive charm, no one could compare with this Second Princess.

units.source_text: 但心中毕竟恋念六女公子，巴不得早点和她见面。

en.t: Yet in his heart he still longed for the Sixth Princess and could hardly wait to see her soon.

units.source_text: 可见他对六女公子的爱情决非浅鲜。

en.t: This shows that his love for the Sixth Princess was by no means slight.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，但和二女公子对面相晤期间，爱情大约一点也不衰减，所以又对她立下生生世世为夫妇的誓愿，话语滔滔不绝。

en.t: Even so, while he sat face to face with the Second Princess, his love for her seemed not to diminish at all, and he again vowed that they would be husband and wife through life after life, speaking on without end.

units.source_text: 二女公子听了他的话，答道：“人命实甚短促，在这短促的‘待命期间内’竟也要受到你的冷遇么？

en.t: After listening to him, the Second Princess replied, "Human life is so very brief. Must I suffer your coldness even during this short 'waiting span' of life?

units.source_text: 那么至少后世不要违背你的誓言，那时我就不怕‘蹈覆辙’，再来追随你吧。”

en.t: Then at least in the next world, do not break your vow. At that time I will not fear repeating my mistake, and will follow you again."

units.source_text: 她一向竭力忍耐，然而今天实在忍不住，就哭起来了。

en.t: She had always tried her utmost to endure, but today she truly could not hold back and began to cry.

units.source_text: 近来她心中每有怨恨，总是千方百计地隐忍，不使匂亲王看出。

en.t: Recently, whenever resentment arose in her heart, she had always done everything she could to hide it and keep Prince Niou from noticing.

units.source_text: 大约现已积集太多，不能再隐忍，所以一经哭出，眼泪便收不住。

en.t: Perhaps too much had now accumulated for her to keep suppressing it, and once she began to cry, her tears would not stop.

units.source_text: 自己觉得可厌可耻，连忙背过身子。

en.t: Feeling disgusted with herself and ashamed, she quickly turned her body away.

units.source_text: 匂亲王硬把她拉转来，对她说道：“我总以为你秉性顺良，定能相信我的誓言。

en.t: Prince Niou forcibly drew her back toward him and said, "I had always thought you gentle and good by nature, and surely able to trust my vows.

units.source_text: 原来你对我也有隔膜！

en.t: So you too have kept a distance from me after all.

units.source_text: 不然，何以只隔一夜就变了心呢？”

en.t: Otherwise, why would your heart change after only one night apart?"

units.source_text: 说着，用自己的衣袖替她拭泪。

en.t: As he spoke, he wiped her tears with his own sleeve.

units.source_text: 二女公子脸上略现笑容，答道：“只隔一夜就变了心的，正是你呢！

en.t: A faint smile appeared on the Second Princess's face, and she answered, "The one whose heart changed after only one night is you.

units.source_text: 从你的言语中可以察觉到了。”

en.t: I could tell it from your words."

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“啊呀，我的好夫人，你的话何等幼稚啊！

en.t: Prince Niou said, "Ah, my dear lady, how childish your words are.

units.source_text: 其实我胸中并不负疚，故很可放心。

en.t: In truth there is no guilt in my heart, so you may be quite at ease.

units.source_text: 无论何等花言巧语，虚伪总是瞒不过的呀！

en.t: No matter how clever the sweet words, falsehood can never be hidden in the end.

units.source_text: 你一向不懂得世间习俗，固然天真可爱，但也使人为难。

en.t: You have never understood the ways of the world, and though that innocence is lovable, it also makes things difficult.

units.source_text: 喂，请你设身处地替我想想吧！

en.t: Come now, please put yourself in my place and think of my situation.

units.source_text: 我的处境真是所谓‘身不由心’啊！

en.t: My position is truly what people call being unable to act as one's heart desires.

units.source_text: 如果我有朝一日得遂青云之志，我对你的爱情一定胜于其他一切女人，这一点我必须教你知道。

en.t: If one day I attain the high ambition I seek, my love for you will surely surpass my love for all other women; this I must make you understand.

units.source_text: 但此事不可轻易出口，你只须保养身体，静待良机可也。”

en.t: But this matter must not be spoken of lightly. You need only take care of your health and quietly wait for the right opportunity."
